value.headline: NOR edges it
value.summary: Norwich (NOR) comes out on top overall, leading in result by an average of 6.333 places and gaining 1.333 positions per race, while also posting a faster race-pace of 95.78 s/lap compared with Verstappen’s 96.169 s/lap. He is also ahead in consistency (3.56 s versus 3.807 s) and in the head-to-head record (2 wins to Verstappen’s 1). Verstappen (VER) shows strength in tyre management (-0.018 s/lap) and overtaking (6 overtakes versus 5), and his peak-pace time is slightly quicker at 90.411 s versus 90.54 s. The comparison is limited by the fact that Verstappen did not finish one of the three races, which drags his result and pace averages.
caveats: VER did not finish 1 of these races, which drags their result and pace averages.
value.rule_summary: NOR leads on result, positions gained, consistency, race pace, most clearly on result (6.333 places). VER answers on tyre management, overtaking, peak pace. Across 3 races: head-to-head 1-2, NOR faster by 0.389s per lap on average, points 28-52.
